note: The photo is a binary JPG and is not in the repo. Download it with the URL above, then run: python -m bgremove --input <folder-with-red-mug.jpg> --out clean/. The mug sits right of centre, so the image-centre pixel is background (alpha 0); product_centre_alpha is the middle of the detected bounding box. First-run seconds include the one-time U2-Net model download.
